actual_source_contacts.method: Actual triangle edge intersects adjacent triangle

all_part_contact_graph.method: Full semantic-part graph using actual vertex/triangle boundaries, enclosed points, edge/triangle and coplanar-edge intersections. AABB only rejects separated pairs; it never establishes contact.
all_part_contact_graph.limits: Geometric connectivity, not structural design, attachment strength, irrigation, load, or simulation behavior. Open folded foliage is not treated as a closed support hull.

limits: All planar triangle orientations screened, including sloped finish faces. Coplanar grouping is tolerance limited; advisory exposure probe is not full visibility proof.
Opposite-facing butt contacts are excluded. Floor boundaries are not exposed finish failures.
Connectivity is actual geometry, not structural strength, load or installation acceptance.
